# NEW 2026-11-21 v9.5 Subject System & 24 Overlord Deep Interactions (Slot 69, oe_sub_). Generated by gen_subject_interactions.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Increment actor interaction counter cleanly (country scope).
oe_sub_bump_act = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_sub_act_count } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_sub_act_count value = 1 }
    }
    else = {
        change_variable = { name = oe_sub_act_count add = 1 }
    }
}

# Slot 69 entry effect (country scope, called by gen_mainline_lock.py Slot 69 & oe_sub_pulse.txt).
# Deduplicated per calendar month via oe_sub_ran_m; runs lightweight quarterly inspection only.
oe_sub_monthly = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            is_rebel_country = no
            NOT = { var:oe_sub_ran_m ?= oe_sub_m_now }
        }
        set_variable = { name = oe_sub_ran_m value = oe_sub_m_now }
        if = {
            limit = {
                OR = {
                    current_month = 1
                    current_month = 4
                    current_month = 7
                    current_month = 10
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    OR = {
                        any_subject = { is_subject_type = oe_sub_protectorate_duhu }
                        has_variable = oe_sub_duhu_anchor_cnt
                    }
                }
                oe_sub_sync_duhu_anchors = yes
            }
            if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_sub_has_ward }
                oe_sub_check_wards = yes
            }
        }
    }
}

# O(1) quarterly check of the 4 historic Frontier Protectorate coordinates (kashgar/beshbalik/nurgan/thang_long).
oe_sub_sync_duhu_anchors = {
    save_temporary_scope_as = oe_sub_lord
    set_variable = { name = oe_sub_duhu_anchor_cnt value = 0 }
    location:kashgar = {
        if = {
            limit = { has_owner = yes }
            owner = {
                if = {
                    limit = { is_subject_of = scope:oe_sub_lord is_subject_type = oe_sub_protectorate_duhu }
                    add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_sub_duhu_anxi years = 2 mode = replace }
                    scope:oe_sub_lord = { change_variable = { name = oe_sub_duhu_anchor_cnt add = 1 } }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { this = scope:oe_sub_lord scope:oe_sub_lord = { any_subject = { is_subject_type = oe_sub_protectorate_duhu } } }
                    scope:oe_sub_lord = { change_variable = { name = oe_sub_duhu_anchor_cnt add = 1 } }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    location:beshbalik = {
        if = {
            limit = { has_owner = yes }
            owner = {
                if = {
                    limit = { is_subject_of = scope:oe_sub_lord is_subject_type = oe_sub_protectorate_duhu }
                    add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_sub_duhu_beiting years = 2 mode = replace }
                    scope:oe_sub_lord = { change_variable = { name = oe_sub_duhu_anchor_cnt add = 1 } }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { this = scope:oe_sub_lord scope:oe_sub_lord = { any_subject = { is_subject_type = oe_sub_protectorate_duhu } } }
                    scope:oe_sub_lord = { change_variable = { name = oe_sub_duhu_anchor_cnt add = 1 } }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    location:nurgan = {
        if = {
            limit = { has_owner = yes }
            owner = {
                if = {
                    limit = { is_subject_of = scope:oe_sub_lord is_subject_type = oe_sub_protectorate_duhu }
                    add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_sub_duhu_nurgan years = 2 mode = replace }
                    scope:oe_sub_lord = { change_variable = { name = oe_sub_duhu_anchor_cnt add = 1 } }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { this = scope:oe_sub_lord scope:oe_sub_lord = { any_subject = { is_subject_type = oe_sub_protectorate_duhu } } }
                    scope:oe_sub_lord = { change_variable = { name = oe_sub_duhu_anchor_cnt add = 1 } }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    location:thang_long = {
        if = {
            limit = { has_owner = yes }
            owner = {
                if = {
                    limit = { is_subject_of = scope:oe_sub_lord is_subject_type = oe_sub_protectorate_duhu }
                    add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_sub_duhu_annan years = 2 mode = replace }
                    scope:oe_sub_lord = { change_variable = { name = oe_sub_duhu_anchor_cnt add = 1 } }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { this = scope:oe_sub_lord scope:oe_sub_lord = { any_subject = { is_subject_type = oe_sub_protectorate_duhu } } }
                    scope:oe_sub_lord = { change_variable = { name = oe_sub_duhu_anchor_cnt add = 1 } }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_sub_duhu_anchor_cnt >= 1 }
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_sub_duhu_overlord_network years = 2 mode = replace }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            var:oe_sub_duhu_anchor_cnt >= 2
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_sub_duhu_milestone_done }
        }
        set_variable = { name = oe_sub_duhu_milestone_done value = 1 }
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_sub.60
    }
}

# Quarterly check for court wards / hostages whose 5-year imperial education has completed.
oe_sub_check_wards = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = { any_character = { has_character_modifier = oe_sub_hostage_at_court_char } }
        }
        remove_variable = oe_sub_has_ward
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            any_character = {
                has_character_modifier = oe_sub_hostage_at_court_char
                has_variable = oe_sub_hostage_return_m
                var:oe_sub_hostage_return_m <= oe_sub_m_now
            }
        }
        random_character = {
            limit = {
                has_character_modifier = oe_sub_hostage_at_court_char
                has_variable = oe_sub_hostage_return_m
                var:oe_sub_hostage_return_m <= oe_sub_m_now
            }
            save_scope_as = oe_sub_ward_pick
        }
        if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:oe_sub_ward_pick }
            set_variable = { name = oe_sub_returning_ward value = scope:oe_sub_ward_pick }
            trigger_event_non_silently = oe_sub.55
        }
    }
}

# Helper: spawn requisitioned fleet galleys at actor's capital (if port) or any owned port.
oe_sub_spawn_levied_ships = {
    if = {
        limit = { capital ?= { is_port = yes } }
        capital = {
            create_sub_unit_of_category = sub_unit_category:navy_galley
            create_sub_unit_of_category = sub_unit_category:navy_galley
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { any_port_in_country = { is_port = yes } }
        random_port_in_country = {
            limit = { is_port = yes }
            create_sub_unit_of_category = sub_unit_category:navy_galley
            create_sub_unit_of_category = sub_unit_category:navy_galley
        }
    }
}

oe_sub_spawn_bonus_ship = {
    if = {
        limit = { capital ?= { is_port = yes } }
        capital = { create_sub_unit_of_category = sub_unit_category:navy_galley }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { any_port_in_country = { is_port = yes } }
        random_port_in_country = {
            limit = { is_port = yes }
            create_sub_unit_of_category = sub_unit_category:navy_galley
        }
    }
}

# TEST ONLY. Called ONLY by oe_sub.90 immediate (NEVER reachable from player commands or options).
oe_sub_log_dump = {
    if = {
        limit = { is_ai = no }
        debug_log = "OE_SUB sub=[GetPlayer.MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_sub_rd_total_sub')|0] foed=[GetPlayer.MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_sub_rd_foederati')|0] charter=[GetPlayer.MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_sub_rd_charter')|0] bro=[GetPlayer.MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_sub_rd_brother')|0] duhu=[GetPlayer.MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_sub_rd_duhu')|0] anchors=[GetPlayer.MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_sub_rd_anchors')|0] wards=[GetPlayer.MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_sub_rd_wards')|0] acts=[GetPlayer.MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_sub_rd_acts')|0] m=[GetPlayer.MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_sub_rd_ran_m')|0]"
    }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- Page 68 Dev Test Helpers
oe_sub_test_init = {
    add_gold = 2000
    add_prestige = 30
    add_legitimacy = 20
    add_army_tradition = 20
    oe_sub_bump_act = yes
}

oe_sub_test_make_foederati = {
    random_subject = {
        limit = { country_type = location }
        change_subject_type = subject_type:oe_sub_foederati
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_sub_foederati_muster years = 10 mode = replace }
    }
    oe_sub_bump_act = yes
}

oe_sub_test_make_charter = {
    random_subject = {
        limit = { country_type = location }
        change_subject_type = subject_type:oe_sub_charter_city
        change_government_type = government_type:republic
    }
    oe_sub_bump_act = yes
}

oe_sub_test_summon_hostage = {
    save_scope_as = oe_sub_test_ov
    random_subject = {
        limit = { country_type = location any_character = { is_alive = yes is_ruler = no NOT = { oe_bells_protected_thinker = yes } } }
        save_scope_as = oe_sub_test_home
        random_character = {
            limit = { is_alive = yes is_ruler = no NOT = { oe_bells_protected_thinker = yes } }
            set_variable = { name = oe_sub_hostage_home value = scope:oe_sub_test_home }
            set_variable = { name = oe_sub_hostage_overlord value = scope:oe_sub_test_ov }
            set_variable = { name = oe_sub_hostage_return_m value = oe_sub_m_now }
            move_country = scope:oe_sub_test_ov
            add_character_modifier = { modifier = oe_sub_hostage_at_court_char years = 5 mode = replace }
        }
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_sub_heir_at_imperial_court years = 5 mode = replace }
        add_liberty_desire = -18
    }
    set_variable = { name = oe_sub_has_ward value = 1 }
    oe_sub_bump_act = yes
}

}

oe_sub_test_educate_noble = {
    random_subject = {
        limit = { country_type = location any_character = { is_alive = yes is_ruler = no } }
        random_character = {
            limit = { is_alive = yes is_ruler = no }
            add_adm = 5
            add_dip = 5
            add_mil = 5
            add_character_modifier = { modifier = oe_sub_imperial_academy_grad_char years = -1 mode = replace }
        }
        add_liberty_desire = -6
    }
    oe_sub_bump_act = yes
}

oe_sub_test_ev_30 = {
    random_subject = {
        limit = { country_type = location }
        save_scope_as = oe_sub_ta
    }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_sub_ta }
        set_variable = { name = oe_sub_arb_a value = scope:oe_sub_ta }
        random_subject = {
            limit = { country_type = location NOT = { this = scope:oe_sub_ta } }
            save_scope_as = oe_sub_tb
        }
        if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:oe_sub_tb }
            set_variable = { name = oe_sub_arb_b value = scope:oe_sub_tb }
        }
    }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_sub.30
}

oe_sub_test_pulse = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_sub_ran_m } remove_variable = oe_sub_ran_m }

}
